answer_1.quote: We use three datasets ... XSum, SQuAD, and the ArXiV Paper Abstract dataset ... generated using GPT-3.5-turbo.
answer_1.outputs: Perturbed texts produced by RAFT to subvert detectors

answer_2.quote: We use the Area Under the Receiver Operating Characteristic Curve (AUROC) ... We also measure the True Positive Rate at a 5% False Positive Rate ... To measure text quality, we measure the perplexity of the attacked text against GPT-NEO-2.7B.

answer_4.quote: We conducted a crowd-sourced human evaluation using Amazon Mechanical Turk (MTurk).
answer_4.guideline: MTurk workers were asked to assess the fluency and semantic consistency of the RAFT‑perturbed texts compared to the originals.
